description: This file defines the ValueValidator interface used for validating header values within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for validating values, checking if a validator can handle a particular type, and chaining validators together.

classes.name: ValueValidator
classes.description: Interface for validating header values, supporting chaining of multiple validators.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Validates a given value based on the provided header definition. Throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: canValidate
methods.description: Checks if this validator can validate values of a specific type.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Creates a chained validator that applies this validator followed by another specified validator.
